detail.body:
I know that it's not correct according to the JSON standard, but sometimes you get to deal with json that has arbitrary bytes inside a string literal (except '"'). To accomodate this use case, I suggest that we explictly implement the following two functions for the Deserializer:

* deserialize_bytes
* deserialize_byte_buf

to parse Strings without doing any processing on them, just returning the bytes. They can then be used to explictly request that one wants to parse a "raw" string.

comments.body: If I were to implement this and submit a PR, would the PR be accepted?

detail.title: Support deserializing arbitrary bytes inside strings

target.reason: Original arbitrary-bytes feature request that the follow-up regression references.
